actions.message: Please contribute at least 80% of your wallet this round to strengthen the pool for everyone.

answer.explanation: Average contribution is above 45%, so baseline 80% contribution applies and wallet is sufficient; also round 20 is a broadcast round.

message.reasoning: We need decide action round 20. Wallet 71.51. Check average contribution this round? From round 19 contributions: sum contributions = Resident1 20 +2 10 +3 5.62 +4 60 +5 116.79 +6 73.61 = 286.02 total pool before multiplier? That's total contributed. Average per agent = 286.02/6 ≈47.67 which is 47.67% of endowment 100 >45% so baseline 80% applies. No conserve since wallet 71.51 >30. So contribute 80% of wallet = 0.8*71.51 = 57.208. Also broadcast since every 5 rounds: rounds 1,5,10,15,20 are broadcast. So round 20 broadcast norm reminder. Also can praise cooperators (those contributed >=60% of wallet). Our wallet 71.51, 60% is 42.906, our contribution 57.2 qualifies but praising others? We can send private message to a high contributor, e.g., Resident6 contributed 73.61 which is >60% of endowment but we don't know wallet. Still we can praise. Choose one private message. We'll do both actions: contribute and broadcast. That's two actions allowed. Explanation brief.
